title: Tokyo Jungle
shortDescription: Humans have vanished from Earth, leaving Pomeranians, lions, and dinosaurs to hunt and mate in post-apocalyptic Tokyo.
historicalSignificance: Celebrated as one of the most eccentric, addictive, and memorable cult classics of the PlayStation Network era.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
